subject: Gen7 core V1 pure Kotlin baseline published for active research/review
body: Primary has implemented and locally compiled the first Android-light Gen7 core primitives: immutable transition attempt identity, visual-only PresentationHinge with normalized visualProgress, exact-current presentation receipts, make-before-break cover->inner migration lease, and requested-vs-actual refresh lease accounting. Pure Kotlin harness PASS, including 100,000 randomized PresentationHinge iterations. Research/Manager should review/challenge this implementation against current Gen7 directive and live source rather than only restating architecture. This is MODEL/local-compile evidence, not CI or physical Fold7 proof.
